comment: add a ? icon inside the "HI" menu item, that when presed will start a on screen teturial, that will explain all functions of jynx interactivly and beautifuly presented and when the user is done with the teturial the ? icon stays on and when he hovers any jynx field there will be a small bubble explaining what it is and functionalities until he goes back to hi menu item and clickes on ? to turn it off
actionLog: PR #114: added a "Help mode" toggle (? icon) inside the Hi dropdown — starts a short guided tour of the toolbar's own buttons (reusing each button's existing title text, no new copy authored), then settles into a persistent hover-bubble mode until toggled off again from the same menu. No live/Playwright verification possible in this environment (no working dev-mode login, and Playwright's browser download is blocked by this sandbox's network allowlist) — build-verified only; flagged in the PR for a manual click-test before merging.
